fields.System.Title: INV-605 — Report stock expiring soon
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want a list of stock approaching expiry, so that it can
be sold, discounted, or moved before it becomes a write-off.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a horizon in days, when I run the report, then I get every batch expiring
  • within it, with quantity and location.
  • - Given the report, then it can be filtered by product, zone, and warehouse.
  • - Given the report, then it shows quantity already reserved separately from free stock.
  • - Given the report, then it is sorted by expiry date, soonest first.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, batch |
| Risks | Live aggregate query degrading over time ([doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
